Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped at a red light in the left lane of the roadway in Pasadena, Texas, when the rear of the vehicle
was struck by Driver 2, whose vehicle was traveling behind at a speed the responding officer judged too close for
conditions. Driver 1 confirmed the collision occurred as described, and Driver 2 acknowledged the impact. Two
independent witnesses on the adjacent sidewalk gave statements consistent with the sequence of events, and scene
photographs were taken. The damage to the rear bumper and trunk area of Driver 1's vehicle is consistent with the
reported force of the impact. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat at the time, and both the officer and
the witnesses confirmed Passenger's presence in the vehicle. Passenger reported pain in the left knee at the scene
and was evaluated by medical personnel, but it is not yet clear whether the injury resulted from this crash. No prior
damage to the vehicle is known to the officer or to Driver 1. Driver 1 was identified as the named insured on the policy
covering the vehicle, and no citations were issued pending further review.
